About.heading: A Sala do Banquete
About.paragraph1: A Sala do Banquete is a sophisticated space dedicated to creating unforgettable moments. With an innovative approach that blends gastronomy, art, and entertainment, we specialize in memorable events.
About.paragraph2: Founded by Liliam Müller, our venue has become a reference in Vitória-ES for offering personalized experiences, elegant settings, and a careful selection of artists and producers. Every event is unique, reflecting our commitment to excellence.

Metadata.title: Privacy Policy – A Sala do Banquete
Metadata.description: How Sala do Banquete handles the personal data sent through the website's forms and when buying e-books, in line with Brazil's LGPD.

Privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: This policy explains, in plain terms, which personal data Sala do Banquete handles when you use this website, why, and what your rights are under Brazil's General Data Protection Law (Law No. 13,709/2018, LGPD).

controller.title: Who is responsible for your data
controller.body: A Sala do Banquete – Liliam Müller, located at R. Constante Sodré, 364 - Santa Lucia, Vitória, ES, Brazil, is the controller of the personal data handled through this website. For any privacy matter, contact us at the email address at the end of this page.

collected.title: What data we collect
collected.body: The website receives personal data through the quote request and etiquette class enquiry forms:
items: Type of service (quote) or class of interest
Expected event date and number of guests (quote only)
collected.note: When you buy e-books, the data is entered on the sales platform (see "E-book purchases" below). We do not ask for sensitive data (such as health, religion or ethnic origin). Please do not include this kind of information in the message field. If you accept analytics cookies, Google Analytics also collects browsing data (see "Cookies" below).

flow.title: How the data reaches us
flow.body: The forms do not send anything to a Sala do Banquete server. When you click send, your own browser builds the message and opens WhatsApp or your email app with it already filled in. You review the text and decide whether to send it. The data only reaches us if you send the message there, and nothing is stored on the website.

payments.title: E-book purchases
payments.body: E-books are sold through an external sales platform. When you click buy, you leave this website and enter your name, email, ID documents and payment details directly on the platform, under its own privacy policy. The website does not receive or store payment details, ID documents or passwords. The platform informs Sala do Banquete of the purchase details needed for delivery and customer service, such as name, email and the e-book purchased.

purpose.title: What we use it for
purpose.body: We use the data only to answer your quote request or class enquiry, to organize your event or class if you hire us and, for e-book purchases, for delivery and customer service about the purchase. If you accept analytics cookies, we use browsing statistics to understand how the website is used and to improve it. We do not use your data for advertising, we do not sell it and we do not share it with third parties for commercial purposes.

legalBasis.title: Legal basis
legalBasis.body: For quote requests and class enquiries, processing is based on Article 7, item V, of the LGPD: preliminary steps related to a contract, at the request of the data subject. For e-book purchases, the basis is the performance of the contract (the same Article 7, item V) and compliance with legal and tax obligations (Article 7, item II). The acknowledgment checkbox on the forms exists to make sure you have read this policy before sending. Analytics cookies (Google Analytics) are only used with your consent (Article 7, item I), which you can withdraw at any time under "Cookie preferences" in the website footer.

sharing.title: Who the data is shared with
sharing.body: To work, the website and our customer service rely on a few third-party services:
items: WhatsApp (Meta) or your email provider, which carry the message you decide to send.
The e-book sales platform, which processes payment and delivery and informs us of the purchase details.
Google (Gmail), which hosts Sala do Banquete's mailbox.
Vercel, the company that hosts the website and logs technical access data, such as IP address and browser type, for security and operational reasons.
Google (Google Analytics), only if you accept analytics cookies: receives browsing data to produce usage statistics for the website.
sharing.note: Each service follows its own privacy policy, and some may store data outside Brazil (LGPD, Article 33).

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: Quote and class enquiry conversations and emails are kept for up to 12 months after the last contact when no contract is signed. If there is a contract, the data is kept for as long as needed to meet legal and tax obligations. E-book purchase records are kept on the sales platform for the period required by tax law. Google Analytics browsing data is kept by Google for 2 months; after that, only aggregate statistics that do not identify visitors remain. You can ask for deletion of anything we are not legally required to keep at any time.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: The website stores the following information in your browser:
items: NEXT_LOCALE (required): cookie that stores your chosen language (Portuguese or English) and expires when you close your browser.
cookie-consent (required): a record, in your browser's local storage, of your choice about analytics cookies. It lasts 12 months so the notice does not appear on every page.

_ga and _ga_<ID> (analytics, only with your consent): Google Analytics cookies that count visits and record pages viewed, where the visit came from (for example, Instagram or Google), device type, approximate city and actions such as requesting a quote, enquiring about a class or clicking to buy an e-book. They expire after 12 months.
cookies.note: Analytics cookies are only turned on if you click "Accept" on the cookie notice. You can change your mind at any time under "Cookie preferences" in the website footer; if you decline, the Google Analytics cookies are deleted. Google Analytics does not store your IP address. We do not use advertising cookies or tracking pixels, and Google's advertising features are turned off.

security.title: Security
security.body: The website is served only over an encrypted connection (HTTPS) and uses security headers that make common attacks harder. Since the forms do not store data on a server, there is no database of quote requests or enquiries on the website that could leak.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: Under the LGPD (Article 18), you may, at any time and free of charge:
items: Confirm whether we process your data and access it.
Correct incomplete, inaccurate or outdated data.
Find out who we share your data with.
Withdraw your consent to analytics cookies under "Cookie preferences" in the website footer.
rights.note: To exercise these rights, write to the email address below. We will reply within 15 days. You may also file a complaint with Brazil's National Data Protection Authority (ANPD).

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: If this policy changes, the update date at the top of this page will change too.

CookieBanner.title: Cookies and privacy
CookieBanner.body: We use Google Analytics cookies to understand how the website is used, such as which pages are visited and where visits come from. They are only turned on if you accept. <link>Learn more</link>.
